steps.content:
Postcard content:

OwO has found my hometown! Hmph, such a dummy clapper like you must be having a hard time in Syndicate without me. You must be missing OwO and OwO's lion dance very much!
Wait for me! Oh, I have very good news to tell you in person, and that's important!

She clearly asked an adult to write it for her. A photo is attached to the back of the postcard, in which OwO lifts the lion head proudly in front of an ethnic village. The golden writing on the plaque at the entrance reads Goldionville.
You look down at the prideful lion dancer in the photo, then look up at the girl before you who's covered in dirt rolling on the ground, picking a fight. You sigh.
This is what the alarm was referring to... "An extremely dangerous Sinner is causing trouble on the street"?
Staring at the petite figure making a scene in the crowd not far ahead, even the fully armed guards lower their weapons a little awkwardly.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'm sure about it this time! It must be that jackass with the hat!
Standing in the crowd, OwO scans the gathering pedestrians and points at a lucky spectator.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You seem sneaky! Did you steal my lion head?!

steps.speaker: Hooligan
steps.content: Did you just call me a jackass?!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hump! Why are you getting mad if you know you're innocent? It must be because you're feeling guilty!
OwO roars in the direction of the hooligan, bursting out a string of golden sound waves.
Luckily, the hooligan dodges it agilely, though toppling a water bucket in front of someone's house behind him.

steps.speaker: Hooligan
steps.content: I didn't do it! I said it's not here, that whatever freaking head of yours!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The lion head! A big, beautiful lion's head! How can you not know it!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I don't care! Liar, liar, liar! Your nose will grow if you lie!
She seems to be aiming at a flowerpot on the windowsill on the second floor of a building this time, shattering it with a furious roar.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I lost it here! If you don't tell me where it is, I'm not leaving!
She sits down on the ground, arms akimbo. The surrounding residents dare not get close to her or make eye contact, lest they become the next unlucky target of her suspicion.

steps.speaker: Pedestrian A
steps.content: What's this thing she's making a fuss about? Is it some expensive toy?

steps.speaker: Pedestrian B
steps.content: Who cares what it is. All I know is that this little girl wrecked a lot of our things.

steps.speaker: Pedestrian C
steps.content: Whose kid is that? She needs to be disciplined! We already told her we'd never seen it but she insists on harassing every resident here... Just shut up.

steps.speaker: Pedestrian D
steps.content: Didn't someone call the police already? Why aren't those publicly-funded idiots from DisCity here to arrest her yet?
Cough...
Being the leader of publicly-funded idiots from DisCity, you've observed enough to have a grasp of the situation here. You make your way through the crowd.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmph, no one can hold me back now. I won't give up if I don't find the lion head!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Just be nice and give it back to OwO, or I will... Eh?
She watches the changeless uniform and leather shoes approaching her and realizes she's seen them before.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You're...
She looks up and finally recognizes the face in front of her.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Little clapper!
OwO grabs onto your thighs as if clutching a lifeline.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The guys behind you are... the bunch of assistants who follow you!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Good timing! I order you guys to make them hand the lion head back to OwO! Right now, immediately, at once!
She grips the hem of your jacket and looks up at you with red-rimmed eyes, only to hear a cold and resigned answer.
You've abused your special power and disrupted public order. You'll have to come with us, Sinner.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Abused my special power?! Disrupted public order?!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: How dare you, you mere clapper! You dare to defame OwO, the fabulous, genius, number one lion dancer in the entire universe?!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Why don't you obey my order? Help OwO look for the lion head!
The girl who was just making a scene in the middle of the street is now punching and kicking the air in the interrogation seat.
You used your special power casually and arbitrarily on the street just now. Are you going to deny that?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmph!
Or... Have you actually never heard of the rules and regulations concerning Sinners?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I don't talk to cowards who won't stand up for OwO!
She puffs her cheeks and turns her face away, uninterested in the topic of Sinners.
...Are you sure you lost your lion head in Syndicate?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I'm not answering you. You're not gonna help me find it anyway. You even took me away and locked me up! Bleh!
She sticks out her tongue and turns to face another direction rashly.
It looks like if you don't cheer OwO up first, the conversation won't go anywhere.

options: I can only help you if you answer my questions.
I was helping you by getting you out of there.

choices.text: I can only help you if you answer my questions.
I was helping you by getting you out of there.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh?! You've gotten cocky since the last time I saw you! How dare you negotiate terms with OwO?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Huh?! You've gotten cocky since the last time I saw you! How dare you bend the truth in front of OwO?
...Well, you see, we haven't seen each other in a while.
During these days, other than the message on the postcard, I learned nothing about the corruption of your special power and your physical condition.
I don't know how and where you've been, what you've experienced. How am I supposed to help you... help the genius, pretty, world number one lion dancer deduce her lion head's whereabouts?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm...
The improvised speech is a bit too lengthy for OwO. She considered for a long while before glancing at you a little skeptically.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It seems to... make a little bit of sense?
Then can the genius, pretty, world number one lion dancer tell me what exactly happened to you while I was away?
How did you get home? What did you encounter on the way? How come your special power seems to have intensified a lot in just a few months?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Must I answer so many questions just to find the lion head? That's annoying!
Well...
You glance at the half-blank Sinner file on hand and feel a little helpless. The little clapper has a job to do too.
All these questions are necessary for reconstructing how the lion head got lost. Um, right, it's all for the lion head.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm... Alright, for the lion head! In that case, OwO will begin with how I found the way home!
She finally steadies her fidgeting limbs.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You know it, right? When I was escorting Stella home, I ran into some really, really bad guys!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: OwO beat them heroically! I gained power! I became a... What's it called again... A...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Exactly! That's it! It sounds a bit lame though...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hold on... Did the lion head get mad and run away because I didn't name it properly?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: OwO wants to name it after I learn about more names, but it seems like we can't wait until then! What should I call it? ...Li-li? On-on?
The conversation is deviating from the original direction. You can only be patient and keep guiding her in the right way.
You beat the bad guys and became a Sinner. What happened next?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: And then? Ohhhhhhh! And then, I used this ability to help a super big caravan! They saw OwO defeat the bad guys and said OwO is the strongest unbeatable superhero in the universe! Awesome like a thunderbolt !

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: <size=32>And very coincidentally, the caravan, which seems to be called something... something... they actually know where OwO is from! And they even traded with people there! They saw OwO's lion head and said it must be a specialty there, the Goldionville!</size>

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But you certainly didn't expect... the bad guys who attacked the caravan to set us up! They had several very powerful guys to hunt down the remnants! And then!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Of course, OwO was not afraid of those guys! OwO pulled out the lion head! And transformed into the invincible super lion dancer! Then swish, swish, swish! Golden light and blue light explode together! I...
Hold on!

<size=29>The exhilarating swishes echo in the interrogation room. That blue light must the energy from Stella. It seems that OwO's Mania power is more than ever, probably because she got some kind of enchantment from the Apostle of Ashes. It's giving you a headache. Suddenly interrupted, OwO seems unamused.</size>

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Why did you stop me? I just got to the most exciting part!
Because it's too exciting, I want to zoom into these "swish, swish, swish" parts. Please explain them in detail so I know how to compliment you concretely!
Your ample interrogation experience has turned you into a great improviser. Handling OwO should be a piece of cake for you.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Mmm... The details are not particularly important, but since you asked... Alright.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I suppose you understand that it's already a splendid achievement that OwO is the sole chosen inheritor of the art of lion dance! But... but even a genius has flaws.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: OwO...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Has always hidden behind others.
OwO's voice sounds a bit muffled. She looks down at the hem of her patchwork skirt. On her waist, the longevity lock loaded with blessings jingles softly as she fidgets.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Every time something bad happens, OwO always gets tucked behind others. Whether it's Deren or the other assistants under you, everyone always stands in front of OwO.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But that one time, OwO and that group of powerless people faced those bad guys on our own.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I didn't know them, but something bad had just happened to them, and they treated OwO with so much trust and kindness...
She gets serious uncharacteristically, looking into your eyes seriously.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I want to become someone who can stand in the front! I want to be like Deren, you, and those assistants under you, to stand in the front!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: What's that word, in...pendent?
Independent?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Right! I want to be independent just like everyone else. Suddenly, OwO feels like the power within me has become even stronger!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: OwO can protect Stella! I can protect you guys too! I can protect everyone in the Drifter Camp!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I wanted to tell you guys this, that's why I...!
She holds her breath, looking slightly aggrieved with her reddened face.
That's why you came back to Syndicate, right?
test
test
test
test
test
test
The good news you wanted to tell me is that you now have power as strong as a Sinner's, and you're independent now, am I right?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I... OwO doesn't know much about Sinners and all that. I just want to show off and look cool, I didn't know... something like that could happen...
Suddenly deflated, she pouts her lips and darts her gaze away.
What happened?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Wh-when I arrived in Syndicate, I-I took a break around there... Then, I was just...
You were just?
The usually high-spirited OwO looks uncharacteristically embarrassed and hesitant now.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I was just distracted for a second, and when I turned around, it, it was already...
The lion head was already gone?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm... It's all your fault! I wanted to make the coolest comeback! And now I've even lost my lion head! Not! Cool! At all!
Didn't you lose it yourself...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I don't care! If you'd helped me just now, I would have already found it!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It's all your fault because you just had to drag me back and ask me a million questions... Ah, hold on!
She looks as if she's just found out about some shocking news.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Th-the questions you asked have nothing to do with finding the lion head!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Waah... The lion head, my lion head... The thief has probably already turned it into a dish by now... Sob...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Sob... I order you! Go and look for the lion head! Right! Now!
...What happened to being independent?

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Mind your attitude when you talk to the genius lion dancer! Don't forget your place!
Yes, yes. I'm the little clapper who's in charge of cleaning up messes.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Go, find the lion head! Off to Syndicate!
I've still got a lot of work to finish...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Exactly, the little clapper's work is to help me find the lion head! Off to Syndicate!

She blew her nose, hopped off the interrogation seat before you could protest, and walked out of the room pompously. To save the Bureau from being bombarded by thunderous roars, you have no choice but to follow her.
It looks like the little clapper is forced to play house with the lion dance star before you find the lion head...
